decision: Apply RULES.md and decisions/ template as pilot
why: Phase-1 pilot: template plus one feature in one repo

decision: Keep o=prev close, c=day total; no synthetic wicks
why: GitHub API returns daily totals only; real intraday OHLC does not exist

decision: Daily mode shows last 180 days, not 365
why: 365 candles at 920px are too dense; 180 fits like a TradingView default

decision: Compute MA over full 365-day fetch, then slice to 180
why: MA50 is continuous from the left edge instead of 49 empty slots

decision: Generalize daily_candles(days, since) instead of rewriting month logic
why: Month and daily share one function; month output must stay unchanged
evidence: cmp of year/month SVG before/after, mock and real data

decision: Daily body width = slot*0.7 (~3.3px) without 4px floor
why: The 4px floor leaves ~0.7px gaps at 180 candles
Exchange-style accents distinct from GREEN/RED and legible on BG

decision: Add check.yml on pull_request rendering all modes with mock data
why: chart.yml runs only on main/schedule and pushes; PR had no CI signal

decision: Commit chart-daily.svg rendered from real starlash7 data
why: README embed should show on PR; mock charts must not be committed
